description: Java source code for ComponentLocationResolver class, which implements location resolution logic for components within the OFBiz framework, including methods to resolve locations and retrieve base locations based on component configuration.

classes.name: ComponentLocationResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves component locations into URLs, handling component-specific path logic within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a string location into a URL, converting component-relative paths into file URLs.

methods.name: getBaseLocation
methods.description: Extracts and constructs the base location path for a component, handling component name extraction and root location retrieval.
